# NJMTECH

> Personal portfolio of Nhlanhla Junior Malaza, also known as NJMTech: a South Africa-based Software Developer, DevOps Engineer, Full Stack Developer, and AI Integrations Specialist.

NJMTECH is the personal portfolio of Nhlanhla Junior Malaza. The site presents his software engineering work, projects, blog, and contact information across web development, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and AI integrations.
